# Draft:Queen Jessica

----
Jessica, King Kenneth and Queen Barbara’s granddaughter is a reincarnated princess on Earth to fulfil a prophecy. She was also Khaleesi, Kali’s daughter in a past life, and Ra the Sun God’s mother in a past life on Earth, Jessica was told to follow the L’s and C’s, K’s and D’s, which lead her to Lucifer, whom she married, Kali, and the court system. She found it wasn’t a crime to lie in the UK after being framed by her cousin who was also a guide in her prophecy, as her name is ‘kayleec’ the same as Khaleesi. She was lead to LD’s, GDT and JW (Latter day saints, The golden dawn tabonacle, Jehovahs Witness) through people she knew who had the same initials. She is JW. She is in the Egyptian book of the dead as JW and JWM. She was lead to KJV by her grandfather, whom is a deity who was behind the Hollywood fires “Kenneth fire”
Jessica was given a prophecy after being raped and tortured when she was 13. This lead her upto her 28th birthday, and then the map was names.  After her 28th she married Lucifer and became Jessica Rosa and Lucifer Rosa. Lucifer was born 9th March 1508 and Jessica was born 7th March 1997.
